latest_run_sync_rule: For horses with at least one career start, recent_runs[0].date must equal source_latest_run_date from the refreshed history source.
interpretation: All frozen race JSONs predate the new structured recent-run completeness schema, so all 83 runners are intentionally blocked.
Under v3, these inputs remain valid historical artifacts but are not eligible for a new ranking or live decision.
The source_latest_run_date cross-check directly targets the 12R failure mode where a newer same-class run was omitted from a horse summary.
next_required_work: Populate career_starts and the latest three runs (or all career starts when fewer than three) for every runner.
Record history_source_url, source_latest_run_date and history_checked_at_jst from the refresh source.
Require each saved latest run to match the source-reported latest run date.
Re-run the fail-closed gate before any future ranking model.
